subject: Recap + pricing scenarios for Innovex — startup credit & commitment options
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam@innovex.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Recap + next steps from today’s demo (pricing ask)

Sam — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we covered
- Live demo of low-latency chat + batching profiles for your summarization flow.
- Estimated traffic shape you shared: 10–20k short requests/day with 80% having <120 tokens out, some long-form analysis at 2–3k tokens for 10% of calls.

Key asks from you
- A target effective price you’re trying to hit ($ / 1M tokens) so we can propose committed tiers that match your unit economics.
- Confirmed budget range for first 12 months (ballpark fine).
- Interest in startup program credit + whether Innovex would be open to a committed-use discount (12 or 24 months).

Numbers I’ll model once you confirm
- 3 scenarios: conservative (10k req/day), mid (25k req/day), aggressive (50k req/day).
- Unit cost sensitivity: current platform list is $X per 1M tokens (see attached spreadsheet) — we’ll illustrate required discount to hit target $/1M.

Next steps
1) Reply with a budget range and rough monthly token estimate for your first-year plan.
2) If you want, I’ll assemble two concrete pricing scenarios: a 12-month committed band and a founders/startup credit path (one-pager + sample PO wording).

Attaching a short spreadsheet with baseline assumptions + two sample bandings — I’ll update after your reply.

Thanks — rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198
From: Sam Torres <sam@innovex.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today’s demo (pricing ask)

Thanks, Rishi — great walkthrough. Quick answers: 

- Monthly token volume (first 12 months): conservative ~75M, expected ~220M, stretch ~480M. Those are token-outs + token-ins combined (we’ll send a more precise breakdown next week).
- Budget range for year 1: USD 120k – 450k depending on discounting and how much of the output pipeline we switch over.
- Startup program: yes, we’re a seed-stage company (raised in 2025). Looking for any founders/credits or trials you can offer to accelerate PoC.
- Commitment interest: open to a 12-month commitment if unit economics make sense. 24-month might be a stretch at this stage.

Can you show an example that gets us to $X / 1M tokens (we’re aiming to hit ~$8k per 1M tokens effective for our primary workload)? Also curious what a hybrid would look like: small upfront credits + graduated committed discounts.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Product, Innovex AI
sam@innovex.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Innovex pricing ask — starter credit + committed bands (need guidance)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Innovex note. They gave a range and a target effective price (~$8k / 1M tokens). They are seed-stage (wants founders credit) and open to 12-month commitment. 

Key asks for redwood pricing proposal:
- Example that reaches $8k / 1M tokens at ~220M tokens/mo profile (this is our ‘expected’ scenario).
- A hybrid path: small startup credit to cover PoC + committed discount ramp (e.g., 12-mo tiered bands).
- Any standard PO language for starter credit + committed discounts? Procurement will want sample wording.

I attached the pricing scenarios workbook and the short startup-terms brief. Can we propose two options to send to Sam by EOD tomorrow?

Quoted earlier in the thread: 
> On Thu, 03 Dec 2026 at 09:15 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sam — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: ...

Cheers,
Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 13:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Innovex pricing ask — starter credit + committed bands (need guidance)

Rishi —
Couple pragmatic options we can send:

Option A (Startup path, low friction)
- $25k startup credit applied up front (covers PoC months).
- 3-month trial SLA, no long-term commit required.
- If they convert to a 12-month committed plan within 90 days, apply an additional 10% credit on first invoice.

Option B (12-month committed band, target-oriented)
- Committed usage: 220M tokens/month baseline.
- Tiered discounts on list price by token bands: 0–100M: 10% off, 100–300M: 22% off, 300M+: 30% off.
- Effective blended price estimate (given current list assumptions in workbook): ~ $7.8k–$9.2k / 1M tokens depending on exact band utilization — this can get them near the $8k target if utilization centers in 100–300M band.
- Requirement: signed SOW/PO and 30 days to start date.

Notes for procurement wording: include explicit credit application and that credits are one-time non-refundable, applied before discounts. For committed band include simple true-up at quarter end and an exit clause if they materially exceed committed growth (we can propose overage rates or auto-escalation).

I can draft an email to Sam with both options and the workbook scenarios. Ben — can you sanity-check the blended math in the attached pricing file?

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam@innovex.ai>, procurements@innovex.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Pricing options for Innovex — startup credit + 12-month committed scenario

Sam — looping back with two concrete paths based on what you shared. I attached the workbook with explicit blended math. Short summary below.

Option A — Startup Credit Path (low risk)
- $25,000 one-time credit applied to the first invoices to cover PoC and early ramp.
- No commitment required.
- If Innovex signs a 12-month commitment within 90 days, we’ll add a 10% one-time conversion credit on the first committed invoice.

Option B — 12-month Committed Band (targeting your ~$8k / 1M goal)
- Baseline commit: 220M tokens/month.
- Discount bands: 0–100M = 10% off, 100–300M = 22% off, 300M+ = 30% off.
- Blended example (assuming 220M utilization): effective price ~ $7.9k / 1M tokens (based on assumptions in attached workbook).
- Terms: signed SOW/PO, 12-month term, quarterly true-up, standard overage rates.

What I need from you to finalize a formal offer:
1) Confirm which option you prefer (A or B) or request a hybrid mix.
2) If Option B: confirm an anticipated start date and whether procurement will issue a PO — if so, we can draft sample PO language.
3) Any special compliance or procurement terms Innovex needs (SOC2 scope, IP clauses).

If you’re good, I’ll send formal docs (one-pager + sample PO) and a DocuSign SOW for the committed band. Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow to walk the numbers.

Thanks — Rishi
